purpose: Records the pre-V2-P01 state of the OpenMetadata integration and what V2-P01 reused / minimally repaired / deliberately left alone. Repository evidence has priority over prior summaries.

production_source.role: MetadataProviderPort implementation; pilot/scoped modes; cardinality enforcement; deterministic sort
static | postgres | openmetadata factory; fail-closed on missing OM URL
bespoke httpx REST client; retries; pagination; typed errors; token redaction in __repr__
OM entity → CatalogTable; canonical FQN construction; PK/FK extraction
OM column → CatalogColumn; nullability policy; PK from constraint
tableConstraints → PK/FK canonical DTOs; declared-only, no inference

existing_tests: tests/unit/integrations/openmetadata/test_openmetadata_client.py (pagination, auth, 401/403/404, retries, cardinality, page limit, HTTP error normalization, FQN URL encoding)
tests/unit/integrations/openmetadata/test_table_mapper.py (FQN preservation, composite FK, missing sql_identifier, incomplete identity)

tests/unit/catalog/test_openmetadata_provider.py (pilot fetch, cardinality, mapping fidelity, unknown table type, LKG preservation, unrestricted-scope prohibition, provenance, error sanitization, live-OM optional test gated on env)
tests/unit/catalog/test_metadata_provider_factory.py (openmetadata branch happy path + fail-closed on missing URL)

configuration_files.src/t2s/configuration/settings.py: openmetadata_url, openmetadata_auth_token, openmetadata_service_name, openmetadata_request_timeout_seconds, openmetadata_max_assets (default 25), openmetadata_max_retries (default 3), openmetadata_pilot_fqns, metadata_provider (default None)
configuration_files.configs/default.yaml: openmetadata_url: null (documentary; Settings loads from env)
configuration_files.pyproject.toml: no openmetadata-* dependency; httpx>=0.27,<1.0 is the sole HTTP client

already_correct_no_change_needed: Exponential backoff retries on 429/502/503/504 and transport errors (openmetadata_client.py:200-210, 226-240)
Typed exceptions: MetadataAuthenticationError (401), MetadataPermissionError (403), MetadataEntityNotFoundError (404), MetadataSyncError (transient/network)
Pagination via paging.after with max_pages guard (openmetadata_client.py:116-157)
Cardinality cap (openmetadata_max_assets, default 25) enforced in both client and provider
Read-only: only GET methods in the client (grep confirms no POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE calls)
DEFAULT_TABLE_FIELDS excludes sampleData / profile / queryHistory / lineage / columnStats / customProperties
Provenance stamped via MetadataProvenance(source_system='openmetadata', source_locator=OM FQN, source_updated_at)
Table type normalization to {regular, view, materialized_view, external, unknown} — unknown does NOT silently become 'regular' (table_mapper.py:181-185)
Declared FK only — no name-matching inference (relationship_mapper.py; RelationshipProvenance='declared_foreign_key')
Composite FK verification (all referredColumns must resolve to the same target table)
operator_ergonomics_gaps: `.env.example` had no OpenMetadata block. V2-P01 added a documentary block (commented out) so operators know which variables to set for a LAB profile. This is a documentation-only change; no runtime code was modified.

runtime_factory.py:62 calls provider.fetch_metadata() without a scope argument. Because OpenMetadataProvider requires either pilot_fqns or a restricted MetadataScope, an operator who sets metadata_provider=openmetadata and openmetadata_url but omits openmetadata_pilot_fqns fails closed at first fetch with 'Unrestricted acquisition is prohibited.' This is CORRECT fail-closed behaviour per V2-P01 §22; V2-P01 does not change the code path. The .env.example note documents the requirement.
not_changed_in_v2_p01_by_design: OpenMetadataProvider — code path already fits V2-P01 §4-§20 requirements
OpenMetadataClient — read-only, retries, pagination, redaction already in place
Table/Column/Relationship mappers — declared-only, no inference, canonical FQN construction correct
CatalogTable / CatalogColumn / CatalogForeignKey / MetadataProvenance — no gold fields; provenance already recorded
MG0 assembly (SchemaRetriever + RelationshipExpander + GroundingBudget + S0) — untouched; MG0 reads CatalogTable regardless of provider
StaticMetadataProvider — preserved for deterministic benchmark/evaluation runs
assessment.wrap_up_finding: The pre-existing OpenMetadata integration is already close to V2-P01 requirements. V2-P01 adds tests (parity, security, leakage guards) and documentation (env.example block); no production code was modified in this phase.

questions_from_v2_p01_section_44.what_existed_before_p01: A complete read-only OpenMetadata integration: client + provider + mappers + canonical DTO + 36 unit tests + factory routing + optional live-pilot test.
questions_from_v2_p01_section_44.what_was_incomplete: Operator documentation only: .env.example had no OpenMetadata block. Not a runtime defect.
questions_from_v2_p01_section_44.what_was_changed: .env.example — added a commented documentary block for METADATA_PROVIDER + OPENMETADATA_URL / TOKEN / PILOT_FQNS / SERVICE_NAME / TIMEOUT / MAX_ASSETS / MAX_RETRIES. No production source files modified.
questions_from_v2_p01_section_44.what_was_deliberately_not_changed: OpenMetadataProvider, OpenMetadataClient, mappers, CatalogTable DTO, MG0 assembly, solver prompt, GroundingBudget, RelationshipExpander, MetadataSyncService, MetadataScope, MetadataValidationGate.
questions_from_v2_p01_section_44.did_MG0_behaviour_change: NO — SchemaRetriever, RelationshipExpander, GroundingBudget, S0 Serializer all unchanged. Provider parity test enforces canonical DTO equivalence.
